messages:
Ana Patel: FY — postmortem for last week's auth-provider outage is up: https://rwd.co/postmortems/2627-auth-outage. TL;DR: provider-side token throttling cascaded into model-registry auth failures. We promised 3 remediation items in the PM: rotate keys + validation, add fallback token-cache + circuit breaker, and add a vendor-monitoring alert. Can we confirm owners and realistic ETAs? Need by EOD so we can commit on the exec check-in. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mike Chen: assigning myself to (1) rotate key + validation. Plan: generate new key, rollout to staging, run full integration smoke, then prod schedule. ETA: 2026-04-02 for staged verification, 2026-04-07 for prod rotation (dependent on on-call window).

Samir Rao: I'll take (2) fallback token-cache + cb. Proposal: implement a short-lived local token cache with fallback TTL 15s, and a soft-fail circuit-breaker that routes to cached tokens when provider 5xx rate > 5% for 10s. I'll put up a PR with tests. ETA: PR by 2026-03-30, rollout 2026-04-06 behind feature-flag.

Rajiv Gupta: I'll own (3) vendor-monitoring and alerting. Need to add an alert for token-service 429/5xx spike + auth latency increase. Also want a synthetic test hitting the provider token endpoint every 30s. ETA: alert and synthetic in PROD by 2026-03-31.

Lina Morales: Adding ops playbook updates to this. I'll update runbooks: "auth-provider-fallback" and "model-registry-auth-failure" with clear run steps + escalation path. ETA: draft by 2026-03-28.

Carol Ng: Two asks: (a) can we get a timeline for vendor SLA negotiation? we should require improved rate-limit RTO in the contract. (b) also add a canary that exercises the entire model-registry auth path end-to-end during off-hours. I'll help with the canary.

Ana Patel: Thanks — please add your owner tags to the postmortem doc under "Remediation owners" so CS/exec can track. A couple of cross-cutting items we should decide now:
- Do we buy a second auth provider as a hot standby (cost implications)?
- For model-registry calls, should we add client-side exponential backoff + jitter everywhere?

Mike Chen: For (backoff) — yes. I can push a small cross-service SDK change to make backoff default. Targeting a minor release 2026-04-09. For second provider: high-cost and complexity; let's first do cache/cb + SLA. We can revisit Q3 if this pattern repeats.

Samir Rao: Agree with Mike. Also note that the incident correlates with prior pattern in Jan where our token burst monitoring didn't trigger early. I've opened a short investigation ticket to scan the last 6 months for similar 5xx/429 spikes on the auth metric. If we find repeats, that bumps priority on multi-provider.

Rajiv Gupta: Quick note on alerts: we should avoid alert fatigue. Proposed thresholds: 5xx rate > 5% sustained for 30s or >10% for 10s. Also add a severity-2 for synthetic test failure > 3 failures in 5m.

Lina Morales: Runbook snippet I'm adding: ```
- If model-registry auth fails: 1) check auth provider dashboard; 2) toggle feature-flag:use_cached_tokens; 3) escalate to vendor Slack + open support case if > 5m; 4) kick on-call rotation.
```

Carol Ng: ops-bot — please create tracking tasks in the remediation epic and ping owners.

ops-bot: Created tasks: RWD-8942 (rotate-auth-key) -> Mike Chen; RWD-8943 (token-cache-cb) -> Samir Rao; RWD-8944 (auth-synthetic-alert) -> Rajiv Gupta; RWD-8945 (runbook-updates) -> Lina Morales. Links: https://jira.rwd/RWD-8942 .../8945

Ana Patel: Great. Two administrative things: (A) add ETA fields in the doc using exact dates, (B) owners — please add a quick risk note if you anticipate blockers. Also, let's have a 15m check-in next Mon at 10:30am to confirm progress (invite will go out).

Mike Chen: Noted — risk: prod rotation blocked if legal needs approval for key handling. I'll flag by EOD if that looks likely.

Samir Rao: Risk: build time for safe rollout + extra QA cycles. If blocker, will request help from eng-sre to run manual verification windows.

Rajiv Gupta: Vendor-side: they promised faster token issuance but no formal SLA change yet. I'll start procurement thread for SLA amendment; can loop legal as needed.

Lina Morales: FYI — I'll include a short "recurrence detection" section in the runbook pointing to the investigation ticket Samir opened.

Carol Ng: If we start seeing repeating incidents across model-registry and auth provider, propose we schedule a resilience retro with platform + infra + product to decide multi-provider vs costly mitigations.

Ana Patel: Agreed on the resilience retro if we see repetition. For now, let's treat this as high-priority remediation set. Closing loop: please update the postmortem doc by EOD with owner + ETA + risk. I'll collate and share with exec. :white_check_mark:
